g.text: T · who said what to whom
the footer shows the common ones; Enter runs any of these
open the ticked sessions, or else the highlighted one, each in a tab of its own. An open
session: go to its tab. A team's row: its members under it, then the team view; a closed
team starts, each member as itself and the lead last
tick or untick the highlighted session (or click its [ ]); on a closed team's row, all its
tick or untick every session shown. On a team's row: add members to the team
how the highlighted session opens: resume · auto-continue (resume and tell Claude to carry
on) · fork (a new session from a copy of its history) · new (a fresh session in its folder)
show how the session ended, under its title (or click the row). On a team's row: its members
under it, or the team back to one row
find by project, title or anything said in a session; Esc clears it
only the open sessions, as the OPEN NOW card counts them (or click the card); again, or Esc,
only the sessions waiting for you, as NEED YOU counts them; again shows all
only the sessions to continue (cut off, unanswered, at a limit and the rest), as TO CONTINUE
move between the project list and the sessions
hide the ticked sessions, or the highlighted one (in the sidebar: the project); nothing is
deleted. On a hidden one: back in sight. On an open team's row, twice: close its members'
show the hidden ones too, or not
pin the ticked sessions, or the highlighted one, above the rest; again unpins
write it a prompt: Enter opens it in a tab with the prompt, Ctrl+B runs it in the
background. An open session: go to its tab, to type there
